title: Endpoint Hayes-class fourth central moment bound
statement: Let ell >= 200, let n be 2 ell + 1 or 2 ell + 2, and let N_n(e) be the degree-n von Mangoldt population of the invertible residue class e modulo x^(ell+1): the sum of Lambda(F) over monic F in that class. Then the sum over the 2^ell classes e of |N_n(e) - 2^(n-ell)|^4 is at most 64 ell^2 2^(3 ell).

provenance.source: Axeyum gf2-lemire lane; proposed as a sufficient analytic cancellation target after exact endpoint-distribution experiments

notes: This is deliberately an open obligation, not a promoted finite computation. N_n(e) is Mangoldt-weighted; it is not the number of irreducible polynomials. The separately checked Hayes/Mobius step subtracts prime-power contributions before inferring irreducible positivity. Exact Axeyum CAS values test the inequality only at bounded levels, and those observations provide no evidence for the quantified statement. The threshold 200 is chosen so the arithmetic implication combines this bound with the established degree-1-through-400 fact; it is not claimed to be sharp. No Autogenesis operation is registered because no checker can establish this universally.
